title: The boundary binary refresh can build go/bin/evolve from a stranded plane HEAD
summary: The boundary binary refresh rebuilds the loop binary when its build stamp is behind HEAD with a go/ change. If the plane main holds a commit that origin does not hold (a strand such as ba61c7341 in cycle 1830), the refresh builds and runs unshipped code. The two-phase landing (ADR-0039 §8.1) stops ship from leaving such a strand, but an older binary, a dossier closeout or a manual commit can still leave one.
fix: Build the refresh from the commit that origin holds (the merge base of HEAD and origin/main), or refuse the refresh and name the ahead commits when HEAD is ahead of origin.
acceptance: A plane HEAD ahead of origin with a go/ change does not rebuild the loop binary from the unshipped commit (red first)
routed_reason: out of scope for the ship-landing lane (brief: secondary finding); the loop chain and the boot refresh are console-owned
